**Allowed origins** (CORS, `worker/src/index.ts`, `app.use('*', cors({ origin: ... }))`): exact match `http://localhost:4200`, plus any subdomain ending in `.pages.dev` or `.workers.dev`.

**To add a custom domain:** edit the `origin` function in `worker/src/index.ts` (lines ~19–32), adding a new `origin === '...'` check (or an `.endsWith(...)` check) alongside the existing conditions — e.g. `origin === 'https://your-custom-domain.com'`. Note: Hono's `cors()` matches array entries only as exact strings, so wildcard subdomains require this function form, not an array. See `worker/src/index.md` and `docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md §4`.
